label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marek,

I would like to formally object to Liliana being named only as reserve and ask you to review the lineup before Friday’s submission.

On 1 October, you wrote that selection would be based on both the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier on 24 October. You also wrote that the players’ coaches would be consulted before the final lineup. As Liliana’s coach, I was not consulted before this announcement.

The qualifier results do not support the current order. Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, beating Maja and Antoni and drawing with Kacper. Igor finished fourth with 4/7. Selecting board 2 from the rating list alone is therefore not consistent with the criteria you announced.

Liliana missed approximately two weeks of training in October for health reasons. She has now returned to her normal level, and her last three lessons have been very good. Her performance in Katowice was also affected by health reasons, yet she still played all her games. Since the -81 on the November list came entirely from that event, it should not be treated as an accurate reflection of her real strength or current form. The present difference between Liliana and Igor is only 23 rating points.

This is not a criticism of Igor. He is a good player and a good boy, and I have nothing against him personally. My objection concerns the selection process and applying the announced criteria fairly to everyone.

Please change the lineup and place Liliana on board 2. If you do not consider the existing results sufficient to make that change, I am also willing to accept a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, with the winner taking board 2. Please confirm which option you will apply, and ensure that the final lineup is corrected before the names are submitted on Friday.

Oksana
